name: backdated_document
description: A posting whose posting_date is earlier than its sim_date and than other posted documents, in an open period.

name: posting_in_soft_locked_period
description: A posting into a soft-locked period: must_succeed by an actor with the capability, must_reject by one without.

name: rounding_many_small_lines
description: A foreign-currency entry with many small lines whose converted amounts need a rounding line.

name: command_retry_same_key
description: Any business event with retry true: sent twice with the same idempotency key.

name: foreign_currency_journal
description: A journal entry in USD converted at the published book rate.

name: reversal_of_internal_document
description: A posted internal document reversed in an open period.

name: negative_stock_attempt
description: An issue or backdated transfer that would make stock negative on its date or a later date.

name: concurrent_issues_same_item
description: Two issues of the same item and warehouse in one concurrency_group, with stock sufficient for both; concurrency itself is exercised by PAR-01.

name: transfer_different_average
description: A transfer between warehouses whose averages differ, under warehouse-level valuation.

name: transfer_through_transit
description: Goods moved to a transit warehouse and received days later, across a month end once.

name: landed_cost_after_partial_sale
description: A freight cost allocated after part of the goods it covers was sold, in the same open period; at steps 3-4 the cost source is the documented test journal (rule 10).

name: landed_cost_after_period_lock
description: A cost allocated to goods received in a period whose inventory area is locked.

name: import_customs_rate
description: A USD import whose customs rate differs from the book rate, with import duty.

name: uom_conversion
description: Bought in cartons, sold in bottles.

name: lot_and_serial_movements
description: Movements of lot- and serial-tracked items, including a lot split across warehouses.

name: stock_count_differences
description: A stock count with both a shortage and a surplus.

name: preliminary_price_missing
description: A count surplus of an item that has never had a receipt or price.

name: degenerate_costing
description: Goods transferred back and forth on one day, and an area left with value but no quantity.

name: partial_fulfilment
description: Partial deliveries, receipts and invoices of one order.

name: return_of_partly_invoiced_goods
description: A customer returns goods of which only part was invoiced.

name: credit_limit_exceeded
description: A sales order that would take a customer over its credit limit.

name: price_below_cost
description: A sales price below the item's current cost.

name: partial_fx_payment_other_rate
description: A partial payment of a foreign-currency invoice at a rate different from the invoice rate.

name: month_end_fx_revaluation
description: Revaluation of open foreign-currency items at month end.

name: netting_receivables_payables
description: Netting a partner's receivable against its payable.

name: tax_rate_change_mid_period
description: A change of a fictional date-effective test tax code in mid-month, with invoices on both sides of the date; not a claim about any law.

name: replaced_and_adjusted_invoices
description: An e-invoice replaced and another adjusted.

name: year_end_close
description: Year-end close with closing entries.

name: one_cost_source_several_receipts
description: One cost source allocated over two partial receipts of the same goods (e.g. 600 then 400 units); from step 5 the source can be a customs declaration.

name: cost_before_receipt
description: A cost recorded before the goods receipt waits in clearing until allocated.

name: import_vat_on_customs
description: Import VAT on a customs declaration, recovered or capitalized per the tax code's import treatment.

name: short_pick
description: A pick confirmed with less than the task quantity; the bin is counted and the rest backordered.

name: putaway_without_free_bin
description: A receipt whose putaway rules find no bin with capacity; the task has no target.

name: fefo_below_customer_minimum
description: FEFO skips a near-expiry lot below the customer's minimum remaining shelf life.

name: handling_unit_split
description: A partial pick from a pallet.

name: count_during_picking
description: Picks after a count confirmation and before its posting do not become count differences.

name: quality_release
description: Goods received into quality inspection, released or blocked.

name: pick_face_replenishment
description: A pick that takes a pick face below its minimum creates a replenishment task.

name: returns_disposition
description: A customer return received blocked and disposed to restock, quality or scrap.

name: transfer_with_bins
description: A transfer between two bin-managed warehouses, with putaway at the destination.
